title: Law Of Banking And Insurance I
modules: Laws Regulation The Establishment Of Banks In Nigeria
The Regulation Of Insurance Business In Nigeria
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded in law as a temporary contract of insurance, quite distinct from the contract contained in the policy and it is binding on the insurer."
The cover note is regarded in law as a temporary contract of insurance, quite distinct from the contract contained in the policy and it is binding on the insurer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the principal law that governs negotiable instruments in Nigeria."
The Bills of exchange Act is the principal law that governs negotiable instruments in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as a legal charge, it does not like a legal mortgage vest a legal estate in the charge."
Even if the instrument is referred to as a legal charge, it does not like a legal mortgage vest a legal estate in the charge.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as a bill of exchange 2."
Explain why a cheque is referred to as a bill of exchange 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the insurer (usually an insurance company) and the insured or assured."
Parties to insurance contract are the insurer (usually an insurance company) and the insured or assured.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an order for payment of money drawn by a banker upon itself."
A bank draft is an order for payment of money drawn by a banker upon itself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the legal mechanisms that are provided to guide the conduct of people in every aspect of human endeavours."
Laws are the legal mechanisms that are provided to guide the conduct of people in every aspect of human endeavours.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract whereby a party wins or loses a stake of money or some object, upon the happening of an uncertain event."
A wagering contract is a contract whereby a party wins or loses a stake of money or some object, upon the happening of an uncertain event.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the "mortgagor" and the lender the "mortgagee" Land is a universally acknowledged security for various forms of lending."
The borrower is called the "mortgagor" and the lender the "mortgagee" Land is a universally acknowledged security for various forms of lending.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the lest of the insured truthfulness in providing information."
Warranties are the lest of the insured truthfulness in providing information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a personal contract and does not run with the subject matter of the insurance."
A policy of insurance is a personal contract and does not run with the subject matter of the insurance.
fib: ______ is the regulatory institution of the insurance sub-sector in Nigeria.
National Insurance commission
The National Insurance commission is the regulatory institution of the insurance sub-sector in Nigeria.
______ is a tripartite agreement between the customer on the first part, the third party liable to pay on the second part and the bank on the third part.
Domiciliation of Payment
Domiciliation of Payment is a tripartite agreement between the customer on the first part, the third party liable to pay on the second part and the bank on the third part.
______ is a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal.
NAICOM
NAICOM is a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal.
______ is a conveyance of interest in a property as security for the payment of a debt or for the discharge of some other obligation.
mortgage
A mortgage is a conveyance of interest in a property as security for the payment of a debt or for the discharge of some other obligation.
______ is an undertaking by a person to pay the debt of another in case that other person fails to pay.
guarantee
A guarantee is an undertaking by a person to pay the debt of another in case that other person fails to pay.
______ is a charge created by a company over specified assets.
fixed charge
A fixed charge is a charge created by a company over specified assets.
______ is a banking practice that regulates dealings with a customer multiple accounts with a particular bank especially when those accounts are in debt.
Appropriation of payment
Appropriation of payment is a banking practice that regulates dealings with a customer multiple accounts with a particular bank especially when those accounts are in debt.
______ is a right that is available to the bank.
Combination of accounts
Combination of accounts is a right that is available to the bank.
______ is one of the recognized ways in which a customer can borrow money from the bank.
Overdraft
Overdraft is one of the recognized ways in which a customer can borrow money from the bank.
______ is a perfect example of security with objective value.
Life policy
Life policy is a perfect example of security with objective value.
